manage.title: Manage SSO providers
manage.description: Add, change and remove the SSO providers people can sign in with.

providers.deleteConfirm: Delete this provider? Its users will not be able to sign in with it.
providers.name: Display Name
providers.enabledDesc: Show a sign in button for this provider on the login screen.
providers.dialogDesc: Connect an identity provider so users can sign in with it.
providers.redirectUriDesc: Register this URL as the redirect or callback URL in your identity provider.
providers.legacyCallbackDesc: This provider was set up before Termix 2.9 and still uses the old redirect URI, which keeps working. To move to the new one, add {{uri}} in your identity provider first, then turn this off.

fields.secretKeep: A secret is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
fields.groupClaimDesc: Optional. The claim path that contains the user's groups. Defaults to groups, roles, then group. Use this for providers with a custom claim (e.g. Zitadel).
fields.allowedUsersDesc: One email per line. Leave empty to allow all.
fields.adminGroupDesc: At every sign in, users in this group get admin and everyone else loses it, even if promoted in Termix. Leave empty to manage admins in Termix.
fields.caCertDesc: Optional. PEM-encoded CA certificate for OIDC providers using a private or self-signed CA. Leave empty to use the system trust store.

links.description: Link a single sign-on account to sign in to this Termix account with it. Your hosts and settings stay as they are.
links.unlinkBody: You will no longer be able to sign in with {{name}}.
links.inUse: That single sign-on account is already linked to another Termix account
links.already: This Termix account is already linked to that provider. Unlink it first.
links.failed: Could not link the single sign-on account
links.lastLogin: Set a password before unlinking your only sign in
links.turnedOff: An admin turned off linking, ask them to link your account

allowSelfLink.label: Let users link their account
allowSelfLink.description: Users can link a single sign-on account to their Termix account in Settings, Security. Off, only admins can link accounts.

silentLoginDefault.label: Sign in with SSO automatically
silentLoginDefault.description: Send visitors straight to the first SSO provider instead of showing the login form. The OIDC_SILENT_LOGIN_DEFAULT environment variable overrides this.

plugin.name: Single sign-on
plugin.description: Sign in with any OpenID Connect provider, GitHub or Google.
